- **Source:** The number comes from Dana's own #north-team post on 20 Aug 2025. It first said 180, and a few minutes later Dana corrected it to 185.
- **Not checked against the document:** I couldn't find the amendment in the shared files. June Osei-Lark has the signed copy if Dana wants to confirm the number there.
- **May not be the current count:** The account renewed on 20 Mar 2026, so if the deck should show today's seat count, I suggested Dana check the renewal terms too.

A seat count isn't a finance figure, and Dana owns the account, so no approval was needed. GBrain was running keyword-only search, so it may have missed notes worded differently.
